# Data Journal by Datakyu

## Overview: Tracking, insights, and tutorials for web analytics.

## Description: In-depth guides and tutorials on Google Analytics 4, GTM, BigQuery, and web tracking. Learn to implement, analyze, and scale data-driven strategies with Data Journal by Datakyu.

## Navigation
- [Home](/): Landing page showcasing featured and latest tutorials
- [Posts](/posts/): Index of all published articles and tutorials
- [Search](/search/): Search interface to find content by keyword
- [Data Stories](/data-stories/): Expert Q&A on common web analytics questions
- [GA4 API Parameters](/ga4-api-reference/): Reference guide for Google Analytics 4 Measurement Protocol parameters
- [About](/about/): Overview of Data Journal’s mission and subscription info
- [Authors | Aziz Dhaouadi](/authors/aziz/): Profile page for the lead author and analytics expert

## Featured Tutorials
- [Advanced GA4 Dashboard Development in Looker Studio Using BigQuery](/build-ga4-dashboard-looker-studio-bigquery/): Build a robust acquisition dashboard with GA4 data in BigQuery and Looker Studio
- [Swetrix, Google Analytics Replacement?](/swetrix/) – Exploring a privacy‑focused, open‑source alternative to GA4
- [Tracking Thinkific Events](/tracking-thinkific-events/) – How to track course interactions on Thinkific via Google Tag Manager
- [Implementing Google Analytics 4 with Segment (Client Side)](/implement-ga4-using-segment/) – Deploy GA4 through Segment for centralized tracking
